stories.title: Woman charged with arson after Oakenholt incident
stories.summary: A 26-year-old woman has been charged with arson with intent to endanger life following an incident in Oakenholt. Tiegan White, of Chester Road, Oakenholt, was arrested after the incident at a property on the same road on Tuesday, 30 June. stories.title: Candidates confirmed for two Flintshire by-elections next week
stories.summary: Flintshire County Council has confirmed the candidates standing in two by-elections on Thursday 9 July. Six candidates are standing in Argoed and New Brighton and seven in Connah’s Quay Central. stories.title: Police target anti-social behaviour with new Connah’s Quay operation
stories.summary: North Wales Police has launched Operation Lens in Connah’s Quay. stories.title: Welsh Water to spend £7m upgrading Pantymwyn wastewater works
stories.summary: Welsh Water is investing £7 million to upgrade wastewater infrastructure serving Pantymwyn and Cilcain, after regulators tightened the standards the current treatment works must meet.
